notes.title: Translation to 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese) and visual upgrades
notes.content:
大家好，《弥诺斯迷宫》（MinosMaze）现已支持简体中文！你可以在这里更改游戏语言 (Hello people, MinosMaze is now translated to Simplified Chinese too! You can change it here):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/74576fe2df3f069b3df16746eaf3fdf55fb2bc29.png[/img]

We also did some upgrades:
[list]
    [*]New visual effects: you can enable or disable each one of them on options menu.
    [*]A larger focal point: this may help some friends that are having Motion Sickness.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: On the edge of new begginings, major changes and the end for the early access!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings once again, mighty heroes![/b]

We come one more time to keep you informed about some significant major changes on MinosMaze. Our focus on a better gameplay experience resulted on the following actualizations for this patch:
[list]
[*]Reworked third person camera, you can now choose if it is fixed, or not, on the view.

[*]Better camera positioning while on a fight.

[*]Vision/Control sensibility improved.

[*]Focal point option enabled, reducing motion sickness.

[*]Scrollbar quantitative on options.

[*]Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]
Game's versions on early access are coming to an end, therefore we will stabilize and fix eventual bugs. It has been a great experience for our team interacting with the community, wich helped a lot to develop MinosMaze. We believe it is time to move forward and full release the official version with a base price actualization.

We hope you all continue to contribute to our game helping us to fix all bugs and problems that may appear from now on.

Thank you all for keeping up so far, we wish you stay with us for the future challenges!

notes.title: Achievements, new options, saves and minor fixes
notes.content:
[b]Greetings adventurers![/b]

 It’s time to bring, once again, some exciting new features to you, heroes of Greece!

[list][*]Can you defeat the mighty Minotaur? Rescue all prisioners? Or beat the game in less than 1 hour?  We challenge you to unlock all MinosMaze’s 19 achievements on Steam! Some will require to start a new game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/e16837a61ff4e2522bf1d3b143820415067e5e86.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/37516175b5ce65f4740ba269cb6be68d6bdb4525.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/9ea5e0bfef9fd3d9d0968acee7ff198a174642ec.png[/img]

[*] New timer available! To see it during gameplay just enable at Options menu, it requires to start a new game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/81b5409ae173995db33a68885bda572ef67d8069.png[/img]

[*] You can invert Y look axis, check it at Options menu.

[*] Now the game saves your gameplay automatically on Steam Cloud.

[*] Lots of small fixes.[/list]

 We hope you have the best time with our game and be able to conquer all challenges proposed. It’s an honour to serve you with the best we can work on.

	MinosMaze’s Team.

notes.title: New translations, minor changes and new "MinosMaze: No Exit Pack" bundle!
notes.content:
[i]Привет авантюристов!
Saluti avventurieri!
Salutations aventuriers![/i]
Greetings adventurers!

Once again we came with some new exciting features on MinosMaze. It is each day closer to be completed and we are proud to put such amount of effort in this.

We did some minor in game changes and translated it to other three languages hoping you feel more comfortable playing our game.

It is now available at Steam Store our new bundle "MinosMaze: No Exit Pack" with both MinosMaze game and exclusive soundtrack: http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1697

[b]In game changes:[/b]
[list][*]Theseus has some new animations.

[*]Animated blood physics more accurate.

[*]Arachne model reworked.[/list]

[b]New translations:[/b]
[list][*]French

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/196148657e785c32a86418a28ef3c4d79dc1de94.png[/img]

[*]Italian

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/bd2ef8fc52cbb916dd6e3460d8e678e14d81fb0a.png[/img]

[*]Russian

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/c2ea187f0805fb522bfc51288edff51a0a069843.png[/img][/list]

Our team wish you all have fun with MinosMaze and count on your collaboration to make it the best it can be. If there are any translation problems or in game bugs please let us know at the community section.

Team MinosMaze

notes.title: Cards, Controls, Soundtrack and much more!
notes.content:
Hello our most esteemed Steam players!

 It's a pleasure to announce the updates on our game. We have been working hard on many changes from gameplay to trading cards and we hope you enjoy these new features.

 The list bellow presents the complete amount of elements changed in this fresh MinosMaze's version.

[b]In game changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Controls were adjusted to a better in game experience.

[*]Camera reworked.

[*]When Theseus is too near to camera he now becomes invisible.

[*]Adjustable player's field of view.

[*]New options to set mouse sensibility.

[*]Options menu is now sectionated by type.

[*]Dropped weapons are targeted to a easier identification.[/list]

[b]Steam community changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New collectible MinosMaze's trade cards.

[*]Set of badges to those who complete their trade cards collection.

[*]Emoticons to be used by your imagination.

ːsteamhappyː
ːWVEːːWHOːːWTDːːWHOːːWHOːːWLLDː
ːWTRːːWLLDːːWVEːːWLRDːːWLLDːːWVEː
ːWVEːːWVEːːWHOːːWTLːːWHOːːWTLː
ːWVEːːWLRUːːWHOːːWVEːːWVEːːWLLUː
ːWLRUːːWHOːːWHOːːWTUːːWTUːːWLLUː

[*]Fantastic player's Steam profile background to personalize your own with MinosMaze's art.[/list]

[b]New original soundtrack DLC[/b]

[list][*]Original soundtrack is ready to download at the store![/list]

We hope you can have the best experience playing our game, if there is anything you would like to comment please let us know.

Team MinosMaze
